final: SELECT AVG(r) AS avg_ratio, AVG(c) AS avg_count FROM (SELECT oi.order_item_id, (SELECT AVG(CAST(ili.derived_product_cost AS REAL) / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili WHERE ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id) AS r, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili WHERE ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id) AS c FROM Order_Items oi)
